competing_explanation: The claim may rely on an outdated policy version, a promotional exception, or a misreading of the return terms.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Refuted if the current policy states a different return window, imposes fees or conditions that prevent a full refund, or excludes standard items from the 30-day full-refund window.
